/* Single-character reference layout: open playfield, compact bottom HUD. */
:root{--dock-bottom:calc(32px + max(12px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)));--skill-size:min(20vw,82px,15vh)}
.hud{inset:0;display:block;pointer-events:none}
.hud .pill{position:absolute;padding:4px 9px;font-size:12px}
.hud .timer{top:calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-top));left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);border-radius:20px;min-width:72px;text-align:center}
.hud .kill-stat{top:calc(46px + env(safe-area-inset-top));left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:10px;background:#10272280;padding:2px 7px}
.hud .hp{left:29%;bottom:calc(var(--dock-bottom) + var(--skill-size) + 6px);width:46%;padding:0;background:transparent;border:0;box-shadow:none;backdrop-filter:none;font-size:11px;text-shadow:0 1px 3px #000}
.hp #hp{float:right}.hp .bar{height:8px;margin-top:2px;border-radius:2px;box-shadow:0 1px 4px #000b}
.hero-portrait{position:fixed;left:7%;bottom:calc(var(--dock-bottom) + var(--skill-size)*.64);width:min(18vw,72px,14vh);aspect-ratio:1;border:2px solid #bba666;border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(ellipse,#547f6b,#172824);box-shadow:0 2px 6px #0009;pointer-events:none}
.hero-portrait img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 14%;transform:scale(1.5);transform-origin:50% 20%}
.hud .stop{position:absolute;right:12px;top:calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-top));width:44px;height:36px;padding:0;border-radius:50%;font-size:10px;border-color:#c3b076;background:#394b31e8}
.controls{left:29%;right:3%;bottom:var(--dock-bottom);padding:0;background:none;gap:5px;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:center}
.controls .iconbtn{width:var(--skill-size);height:var(--skill-size);flex:none;border-radius:6px;border:2px solid #c1ae71;box-shadow:0 2px 5px #0008}
.skills{gap:5px}
@media(max-height:500px){.hud .hp{bottom:calc(var(--dock-bottom) + var(--skill-size) + 4px)}}

#gameViewport{position:fixed;inset:0 auto auto 0;width:100%;height:100vh;height:100dvh;overflow:hidden}#gameViewport>canvas,#gameViewport>.hud,#gameViewport>.controls,#gameViewport>.ov,#gameViewport>#actionName,.hero-portrait{position:absolute}

#result{display:block;padding:18px 12px calc(26px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;touch-action:pan-y;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 10%,#887d45aa,transparent 55%),repeating-linear-gradient(125deg,#413b22 0 8px,#27271c 9px 25px,#635532 26px 28px,#242319 29px 45px);color:#625547}
#result.hide{display:none}
#result *{touch-action:pan-y}
.quest-results{max-width:430px;margin:0 auto;text-align:center;font-family:Georgia,"Yu Mincho",serif}
.quest-ribbon{position:relative;margin:12px 12px 26px;padding:9px 12px;background:linear-gradient(#ec2920,#9c0909);border:3px ridge #ddb243;box-shadow:0 3px 0 #5e320c;color:#fff7db;font:900 23px sans-serif;clip-path:polygon(0 10%,15% 10%,18% 0,82% 0,85% 10%,100% 10%,96% 100%,4% 100%)}
.previous-score{position:relative;margin:0 14% 24px;background:#fff1e5;border:3px double #bc9634;box-shadow:0 2px 6px #000a}
.previous-score>span{position:absolute;left:50%;top:-15px;transform:translateX(-50%);white-space:nowrap;color:#fff6d5;font:700 13px sans-serif;text-shadow:1px 1px 2px #211507,-1px -1px 2px #211507}
.previous-score>strong{display:block;padding:8px 0;font-size:24px}
#newRecord{position:absolute;right:0;bottom:-17px;color:#fff05a;font:700 10px sans-serif;white-space:nowrap}
.result-paper{position:relative;padding:24px 20px 15px;background:linear-gradient(100deg,#f4e3d2,#fff4ec 50%,#f0decb);border:4px double #c0a061;outline:1px solid #f9ddb0;box-shadow:0 5px 12px #0008;text-align:left}
.score-heading{position:absolute;left:3%;width:94%;top:-19px;margin:0;padding:5px 0;border:3px ridge #d0a037;background:linear-gradient(#a76905,#865200);color:#fff2d2;font:bold 14px sans-serif;text-align:center}
.score-section{margin:0 0 15px}
.score-section h3{position:relative;margin:0 0 6px;padding:0 0 3px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid #968b7f;font-size:15px;font-weight:900;line-height:1.3}
.score-section h3::before{content:'◇';position:absolute;left:0;color:#b48d00}
.score-columns{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:5px}
.score-columns label{display:block;font:700 10px sans-serif;white-space:nowrap;margin-bottom:3px}
.score-columns>div:last-child label{color:#a28500}
.score-columns strong{display:block;background:#88745f;color:#fff8e8;border-radius:3px;padding:2px 5px;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.05}
.score-columns .score-value{background:#af8900;border:1px solid #e8ce42;color:#fffbc7}
.group-evaluation{text-align:center;margin:9px 0 18px;font:700 11px sans-serif}
.group-evaluation span{display:block}
.group-evaluation b{display:block;margin:4px 0 0;font:italic 900 25px Georgia,serif;color:#e0fff4;text-shadow:1px 1px #291034,-1px -1px #291034,2px 2px #7347b2,-2px 1px #20a786}
.group-evaluation small{display:block;font-size:10px;color:#473322}
.total-score{position:relative;border:6px double #e1b614;border-radius:40px;background:linear-gradient(#563807,#281609);text-align:center;margin:22px 6% 0;padding:8px;color:#fff329;box-shadow:0 1px 0 #503100}
.total-score span{position:absolute;top:-20px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);white-space:nowrap;color:#fff8da;font:900 17px sans-serif;text-shadow:1px 1px 2px #392304,-1px -1px 2px #392304}
.total-score strong{font-size:27px;line-height:1}
.result-ok{display:block;margin:24px auto 0;min-width:150px;padding:11px 25px;border:5px double #835906;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(#fff778,#ffe34c);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #e9c54d;color:#4b3b1c;font:bold 23px sans-serif;touch-action:manipulation}
@media(max-height:700px){#result{padding-top:8px}.quest-ribbon{margin-top:0;margin-bottom:22px;font-size:20px;padding:6px}.previous-score{margin-bottom:23px}.previous-score>strong{font-size:21px;padding:4px}.result-paper{padding:20px 14px 10px}.score-section{margin-bottom:10px}.group-evaluation{margin:6px 0 10px}.score-section h3{font-size:13px}.score-columns strong{font-size:18px}.result-ok{margin-top:17px;padding:7px 24px}}

html,body,#gameViewport{touch-action:pan-y}
/* Entire results sheet, including OK, is fitted into the visible viewport. */
#result{padding:0;overflow:hidden;touch-action:none}
#result *{touch-action:none}
.quest-results{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:calc(100% - 24px);max-width:420px;margin:0;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);transform-origin:center}
.quest-ribbon{margin:0 10px 20px;padding:5px 10px;font-size:20px}
.previous-score{margin:0 14% 22px}

.result-paper{padding:20px 14px 10px}
.score-section{margin:0 0 8px}
.score-section h3{font-size:14px;margin-bottom:4px;padding-bottom:2px}
.score-columns label{font-size:10px;margin-bottom:2px}
.score-columns strong{font-size:19px;padding:2px 5px}
.group-evaluation{margin:5px 0 8px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;font-size:10px}
.group-evaluation b{margin:0;font-size:23px}
.total-score{margin-top:20px;padding:6px}
.total-score strong{font-size:25px}
.result-ok{margin:14px auto 0;padding:7px 24px;font-size:21px;min-width:140px}
#intro{padding:0;background:#080e18}#intro #start{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;padding:0;border:0;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation}#intro #start img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;pointer-events:none;-webkit-user-drag:none}
.controls{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:5px}.controls .skills{display:contents}.controls .iconbtn{width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:1;min-width:0}.controls .iconbtn img{object-fit:fill}
#guard img{width:175.385%;height:311.795%;}
#s1 img{width:142.997%;height:254.216%;}
#s2 img{width:165.151%;height:293.602%;}
.result-notes{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px 12px;margin:12px 0 0;text-align:center}.result-notes p{margin:0;font-size:clamp(10px,2.9vw,12px);color:#59482f;text-align:center;white-space:nowrap}.boss-hud{position:absolute;top:calc(70px + env(safe-area-inset-top));left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#421918e8;border:1px solid #d8ab67;border-radius:8px;padding:5px 14px;font-weight:bold;font-size:13px;white-space:nowrap}
.cinematic .controls,.cinematic .hero-portrait,.cinematic .hp{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}.controls,.hero-portrait,.hp{transition:none}
#result:not(.hide){animation:resultReveal .45s ease-out}@keyframes resultReveal{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}

/* Four-button layout; user's written left-bottom placement takes precedence. */
:root{--dock-bottom:calc(24px + max(12px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom)));--skill-size:min(21vw,86px,17vh)}
.controls{left:5%;right:3%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr) 1.16fr;gap:6px;align-items:end}
.controls .skills{display:contents}
.hud .hp{left:29%;width:46%;bottom:calc(var(--dock-bottom) + var(--skill-size) + 8px)}
.hero-portrait{left:auto;right:3%;width:min(18vw,78px,16vh);bottom:calc(var(--dock-bottom) + var(--skill-size) + 54px)}
.controls #ultimate{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:2px;border:3px double #ffdb72;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 35%,#65419b,#21123d 65%,#100d22);color:#fff3bc;overflow:hidden;text-shadow:0 1px 3px #000}
.ultimate-mark{font-size:clamp(15px,5vw,23px);font-family:serif;font-weight:900;line-height:1}
.ultimate-name{font-size:clamp(8px,2.5vw,12px);line-height:1.15}
.ultimate-meter{display:block;width:83%;height:5px;background:#100d22;border:1px solid #bb944b;border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden}
#ultimateFill{display:block;height:100%;width:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#dc8bff,#fff184)}
#ultimateValue{font-size:9px;line-height:1;color:#ffe894}
#ultimate[aria-disabled="true"]{filter:saturate(.45)}
@media(max-height:500px){.controls{left:12%;right:12%;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr) 1.16fr;max-width:330px;margin:auto}.ultimate-mark{font-size:15px}.ultimate-name{font-size:8px}.hero-portrait{bottom:calc(var(--dock-bottom) + 110px)}}
/* Reference order: guard, water, earth, ultimate on the right. */
.controls #ultimate{padding:0;border:0;border-radius:3px;background:#171030;display:block}
.controls #ultimate img{inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;transform:none;object-fit:contain;filter:none}
#ultimateFill{stroke:#e8c4ff;stroke-width:4;fill:none}

#actionName.ultimate-nameplate{max-width:92vw;width:max-content;padding:0;background:none;text-align:center;line-height:1.2;isolation:isolate;filter:none;}
#actionName.ultimate-nameplate::before,#actionName.ultimate-nameplate::after{content:none;display:none;}
#actionName.ultimate-nameplate .ultimate-title{display:block;color:#ffe29b;font-family:'Hiragino Mincho ProN','Yu Mincho',serif;font-size:clamp(19px,5.6vw,27px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.035em;-webkit-text-stroke:.6px #36162e;paint-order:stroke fill;text-shadow:0 2px 2px #190d24,1px 0 1px #190d24,-1px 0 1px #190d24;animation:ultimateTitleReveal .14s ease-out both;}
@keyframes ultimateTitleReveal{from{transform:translateY(4px);opacity:0}to{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1}}

#intro .title-stage{position:relative;height:min(100%,150vw);aspect-ratio:2/3;max-width:100%}.title-art{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none}
#intro #start{position:absolute;left:20%;top:56%;width:60%;height:16%;border-radius:35%;background:transparent}
#intro #start:focus-visible,.title-menu-button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid white;outline-offset:3px}

#titlePanel{z-index:20;background:#06111eea;padding:18px}#titlePanel .title-panel-card{width:min(100%,440px);max-height:100%;overflow:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;touch-action:pan-y;background:linear-gradient(#173549,#091d32);border:1px solid #c9ae69;border-radius:16px;padding:24px 20px;color:#f6efd9;text-align:left;box-shadow:0 12px 40px #0008}
.title-panel-card h2{text-align:center;color:#ffdda0;margin:0 0 20px;font-family:serif}.title-panel-card h3{color:#c6e8ff;margin:18px 0 6px;font-size:16px}.title-panel-card p,.title-panel-card li{line-height:1.7;font-size:14px}.title-panel-card ul{padding-left:20px}.title-panel-card .big{display:block;margin:22px auto 0;touch-action:manipulation}.rank-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px}.rank-table th,.rank-table td{padding:10px 4px;border-bottom:1px solid #ffffff25;text-align:right}.rank-table th:first-child,.rank-table td:first-child{text-align:left}.rank-note{color:#b7c8d7}

#guidePanel{z-index:21;padding:12px;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;background:#040e1cf5}

#guideImage{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;pointer-events:none}

#titlePanel{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at top,#592512ee,#160f16f5);padding:12px}
